subject: re-st
title: RE.ST.------PRIN.INFO.
description: Diagram in CMBA-19, embedded in Braxton's argument about Coltrane's late-fifties activity and the move into source-transfer extension via modal forms. (C)RE-ST (restructuralism) is crossed with PRI-INFO (primary information): the question is what restructuralism does to primary information in a context where modal forms (Davis, Coltrane) are reorganizing what counts as primary informational ground. UNF-PI (unification, positively intended) → INT (intention) → PRI-INFO. PRI-INFO branches to SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) and MT-INFO (music information). A separate chain: CN-INFO (controlled information) → AF-COMP (affinity compression) → RE-ST, with CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis) also feeding AF-COMP. Another sub-chain: INTR (interpretation) → IST-F-AT (isolated focus activism) → RE-ST. Structural argument: restructuralism is fed by *three* parallel upstreams — affinity compression (which is itself fed by both controlled information and culture affinity basis — i.e., the existing constraints), and isolated focus activism (fed by interpretation). Primary information has its own independent constituting line through unification-positively-intended → intention. The diagram thus stages Braxton's structural claim that restructuralism in 1960s black creativity is over-determined by both *constraints* (controlled information, culture affinity basis) and *interpretive activism*, while primary information is constituted independently — meaning the crossing of restructuralism with primary information is a meeting of two distinct constituting structures, not a derivation.
